title: We took a real carpentry business and turned it into evidence.
hook: Happy Place Carpentry is a real carpentry business, and we turned it into an evidence graph.
thesis: Happy Place Carpentry LLC of Adair Village, Oregon was archaeologically inventoried into an object graph: one identity object, live services, projects with estimate ranges and warranties, each entry carrying its source. This is the canonical worked example of the FYD pipeline on a real business, and the post teaches what evidence-backed actually means by walking the graph. Happy Place is the human face of the operation: a carpenter, a fence, Oregon rain.
